item.title: Pushing back on New York's newest nicotine tax proposal
item.description: A coalition of business owners and former law enforcement officers protested Governor Kathy Hochul's proposed 75% tax on alternative nicotine products, arguing it will fuel organized crime and harm poor New Yorkers, while proponents argue it will curb addiction and fund hospitals.

item.title: Hochul drubs Blakeman in Marist Poll as 33% of New Yorkers want to leave
item.description: According to the Marist Poll, Governor Kathy Hochul has reached her highest job approval rating in over four years, while most New Yorkers feel they can't afford the high cost of living and 33% of New Yorkers plan to move out of the state in five years.
